deck.comment: The fixed deck of 20 fortune cards. art_key + title + theme + numeral are the card's identity and never change — one illustration per art_key. Gemini picks which cards make today's deck and writes only their words; it can never invent a card name or an art key.

nav.comment: Back button: history.back() when there is history, otherwise this deeplink hands control back to the app shell.

art.comment: Placeholder card art ships inline in the client. Set baseUrl once the real illustrations exist and the client loads {baseUrl}/{art_key}.{ext} full-bleed inside the card frame — no code change.

draw.hint: Know what your card says about today

error.body: Your card could not open. Please try once more.

sampleDeck.title: The Radiant Sun
fortune: The clouds of the last few days are moving aside.
In the coming days your energy will feel new again.
sampleDeck.finding: Your strength is returning. Where to spend it first is the one thing this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which work suits your energy right now — your kundli holds that answer.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Radiant Sun' card today — what does it mean for me?

sampleDeck.title: The Guiding Star
fortune: A hope you had almost put down will come back this week.
The way ahead is being lit, one step at a time.
sampleDeck.finding: Hope is coming back to you. Which hope is worth walking towards is still to be understood.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which hope your stars are backing now — a pandit ji reads it in your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Guiding Star' card today — what does it mean for my future?

sampleDeck.title: The Gentle Strength
fortune: A matter that felt heavy will start feeling lighter.
Your calm will do more this week than your speed.
sampleDeck.finding: You are stronger in this matter than you think. Where to use that calm is the open question.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Where your patience will pay the most — your kundli points to it. Ask a pandit ji.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Gentle Strength' card today — what does it mean for me?

sampleDeck.title: The Turning Wheel
fortune: The time that had slowed down is about to turn.
What you started long back will move again this week.
sampleDeck.finding: Your time is turning in your favour. How far this turn takes you is still to be read.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: How long this good phase runs for you is written in your kundli — ask and know.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Turning Wheel' card today — how will my coming time be?

sampleDeck.title: The Golden Chariot
fortune: A journey or a change of place is taking shape.
The reins are in your hands this week.
sampleDeck.finding: Movement is coming — a trip, a move, or a change. Which direction is right is still open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which direction is lucky for you — your kundli says it clearly. Ask a pandit ji.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Golden Chariot' card today — what does it mean for travel?

sampleDeck.title: The Golden Empress
fortune: Warmth is returning to your home in the coming days.
Something you cared for is ready to bloom.
sampleDeck.finding: Care you gave at home is about to come back to you. What it blooms into is still to be seen.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: What your home is ready to receive now — a pandit ji reads it in your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Golden Empress' card today — what does it mean for my home?

sampleDeck.title: The Full Home
fortune: A family matter will settle more easily than you expect.
This week the house will feel fuller than before.
sampleDeck.finding: The house is moving towards peace. Who takes the first step is what this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Who should make the first move at home — your kundli points to it clearly.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Full Home' card today — what does it mean for my family?

sampleDeck.title: The Steady Emperor
fortune: Your steady work is being noticed more than you know.
In the coming days your word will carry weight.
sampleDeck.finding: Your standing at work is rising quietly. Where to use that voice is the open question.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: When to speak up at work — the right moment is marked in your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Steady Emperor' card today — what does it mean for my work?

sampleDeck.title: The Skilled Hand
fortune: The skill you keep practising is close to paying you back.
One more round of effort and it will show.
sampleDeck.finding: Your craft is nearly ready to be seen. Which door to knock on first is still to be understood.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Which door will open for your skill — your kundli holds it. Ask a pandit ji.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Skilled Hand' card today — what does it mean for my career?

sampleDeck.title: The Even Scales
fortune: A matter that felt one-sided will find its balance.
What is fair will come back to you this week.
sampleDeck.finding: Balance is returning to a matter you carry. When it settles is what this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: When this matter settles for you — that timing lives in your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Even Scales' card today — what does it mean for my work matter?

sampleDeck.title: The Two Hearts
fortune: A closeness you were unsure about will feel steady again.
In the coming days one honest talk will change a lot.
sampleDeck.finding: A relationship is asking for one honest talk. When to have it is the question this leaves.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: The right time to open your heart — a pandit ji reads it in your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Two Hearts' card today — what does it mean for my relationship?

sampleDeck.title: The Three Cups
fortune: Good news in the family will bring people together.
This week a small celebration is on its way.
sampleDeck.finding: A happy occasion is forming around you. What it will be about is still to be seen.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: What joy your stars are preparing — your kundli says it. Ask a pandit ji.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Three Cups' card today — what good news is coming?

sampleDeck.title: The Golden Coin
fortune: A new source of income is taking shape near you.
In the coming days a small offer will come your way.
sampleDeck.finding: A fresh money opening is close. Whether to take it or wait is the question this leaves.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: Take it or wait — your kundli tells you which one is right for you.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Golden Coin' card today — what does it mean for my money?

sampleDeck.title: The Wish Cup
fortune: Something you have wished for quietly is coming closer.
This week your saving will feel worth it.
sampleDeck.finding: A wish you have held is moving nearer. What has to be done for it is still to be understood.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: What your wish is waiting on — a pandit ji reads that from your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Wish Cup' card today — will my wish come true?

sampleDeck.title: The Patient Harvest
fortune: What you planted months ago is ready to be counted.
Patience is about to give you its fruit.
sampleDeck.finding: Your slow saving is close to being useful. When to use it is what this card leaves open.
sampleDeck.consult_nudge: When to use what you saved — the right time is written in your kundli.
sampleDeck.prefill_question: I got 'The Patient Harvest' card today — what does it mean for my savings?
